info.title: CPRa SDK draft management contract
info.description: Draft contract. V2 server qualification is pending. Existing v1 is separate.

get.description: Read the original operation and, when executionResult.state is ready, one immutable original-input-order result page. Cursor and limit bind the retained execution result; they do not activate or cancel the operation.

parameters.name: monitorID
parameters.description: Stable monitor ID. History is a bounded per-monitor timeline.

202.description: Original validation request accepted or reconciled. Poll GET validation; do not resubmit to poll.

post.summary: Prepare a creation ticket for a frozen collection

get.description: Reads one immutable sealed verdict and bounded original-order result page. 409 validationPending includes Retry-After; interrupted/canceled/expired validation without a verdict is distinct. This read never requests compilation or mutation.

post.summary: Create a private original-file reselection attempt
post.description: Available when the server configures collection reselection; discover support before use. The authenticated caller must remain the original operation owner. No request renews the original operation deadline. Verification and resume are separate explicit steps; neither activates configuration.

201.description: Create a private original-file reselection attempt

default.description: Problem details. No private source data or commitments are returned.

requestBody.description: At most 1 MiB of exact raw file bytes. An empty body is allowed only when end=true. No multipart metadata, file names, URL fetching, archive extraction, JSON or base64 encoding. Total source input is bounded to 64 MiB. Only an identical retry of the most recently accepted part can reconcile a lost reply.
